```python
def transform(grid):
    # Determine grid dimensions
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0]) if height > 0 else 0
    
    # Identify background color (assumed to be the color of the top-left cell)
    background_color = grid[0][0]
    
    # Initialize the result grid with the background color
    result = [[background_color for _ in range(width)] for _ in range(height)]
    
    # Shift the grid to the right by 1
    # The cell at (row, col) in result comes from (row, col-1) in grid
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(1, width):
            result[r][c] = grid[r][c-1]
            
    return result
```
